# UniDesk

> UniDesk is a free, open-source (MIT), peer-to-peer remote desktop application for Windows 10/11, macOS and Linux, with a browser-based mobile viewer for phones and tablets. Tagline: "UniDesk. Anywhere. Instantly." It is an alternative to AnyDesk and TeamViewer.

UniDesk lets a user view and control another computer over the internet by entering its 9-digit address. Video, audio, input, clipboard, chat and files travel directly between the two computers over WebRTC, encrypted end to end (DTLS-SRTP). No account or subscription is required.

## Key facts
- Price: free forever; license: MIT
- Platforms: Windows 10, Windows 11, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Linux x64 (AppImage), phones and tablets via the mobile viewer at https://dev-rehanify.github.io/UniDesk/m/
- Connection: 9-digit address, peer-to-peer WebRTC, STUN NAT traversal
- Video: AV1 > VP9 > H.264 preference, up to 4K at 60 fps
- Security: approval required for every session; optional unattended access protected by a password stored only as a PBKDF2-SHA256 hash, HMAC challenge-response login, lockout after 5 failed attempts for 15 minutes
- Features: unattended access, multi-monitor switching, two-way clipboard sync (text and images), two-way voice chat, request control from view-only, connection quality indicator, "type my clipboard", drag-and-drop file transfer, chat, session recording, screenshots, auto-reconnect, address book with nicknames, remote PC info, view-only mode, idle auto-disconnect, lock PC on session end, session history, invite links (unidesk:// and web links), per-session access requests (full control / view only / files / clipboard / file browsing), remote file browser, one-time access codes, pause sharing, Wake-on-LAN, system-key capture in fullscreen, draw/annotate on the remote screen, custom signaling server and TURN relay, automatic verified updates, LAN mode (no server needed on a local network), self-host kit (signaling + TURN via Docker), runs as administrator, Secure Desktop service for lock screen / UAC prompts / Ctrl+Alt+Del, two-way file transfer, tray mode, start with Windows, dark/light themes
- Author: dev-rehanify
